notes: The programme page for Professional Pilot itself was not among the supplied pages; all facts come from institution-wide pages of University of Nyíregyháza. Tuition 13900 EUR is per semester for non-EU applicants, based on the row 'Professional Pilot BSc 7 13900 EUR 12900 EUR' under the header 'Tuition fee / semester * for non-EU applicants **'. The only dated deadline found (30 June 2026) is for the September 2026 intake on the general application form and is not tied to non-EU/international applicants, so no intake was extracted; the pages say the next application period opens in January 2027 / December 2026 for the September 2027 intake.
